title: Separate every-cut separability from full separability on periodic kagome systems
statement: The source connected periodic kagome family has a size-independent noise window where all bipartitions preserve separability but product inputs become non-fully-separable, with a bounded-score witness and explicit severe preparation cost.

evidence.quote: ## 4. A scalable interval where every cut is separable but the whole state is not
evidence.range_scope: Native partial-prefix kagome thresholds, bounded score, finite time and37-billion preparation requirement.

requires: Periodic kagome n=3L^2,L>=4,unit nearest-neighbour V,H=(1/4)sum_{i<j}V_ij Z_i Z_j and noise gamma*sum_i D[n_i]. Use the source graph/cut and uniform/hexagonal-loop certificates.

Declared local analysis axes X and Q_+=(Z+Y)/sqrt2,Q_-=(Z-Y)/sqrt2; actual control errors must fit the small witness margin. This does not automatically inherit the separate blind-detector test power.
provides: For gamma<2sqrt2 some cut can entangle. For2sqrt2<=gamma<3 every cut preserves separability for all times but a product input loses FULL separability at sufficiently small positive time. For gamma>=3 an explicit LOCC implementation exists.

Clip the squared-global-sum contribution at16 and add6e-6 to preserve the fully separable bound uniformly in n. At gamma57/20 and t1/64, witness expectation approximately-0.0003025181034151; corrected clipped expectation<=-0.0002965181034151.
Exact channel circuit uses2n commuting two-qubit phase gates in six nonconflicting layers and local dephasing, without Trotter error. Processing each shot costs O(n).
assumptions: This is NOT genuine multipartite entanglement:each cut admits a separable decomposition, but those decompositions do not form one fully local decomposition.

A uniform bounded score avoids a range penalty growing with n, not the small-signal sampling cost. Exact noisy-Ising correlator methods already compute many observables; no simulation speedup is claimed.
costs: With conservative margin g=0.00029 and both type-I/type-II errors<=0.01,the source bound requires37482033203 preparations. Each preparation pays n qubits and O(n) gates,readout and processing;trusted control accuracy is additional.
contract.units: gamma noise strength; abstract channel time;preparations rather than one free many-body sample.
contract.obstruction: A scientific classification and bounded observable are established in the source;practical large-system detection is not established.

body: Reported exact interval/certificate and circuit results are carried without Capital reproof or execution. The full original package remains held.
